svg.text: Activity: withdraw to mobile money (three-stage payout)
Stage A reserves money in its own transaction, stage B calls the provider with no database transaction open, stage C finalises. Unknown results go to reconciliation.
Name check, fee, then ask for PIN
FAILED releases the hold and the student sees
“money returned”. FIN-04 and FIN-10 from the risk
register are closed by this flow.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
